claim: Warcraft III style public behavior and independent reconstruction, not confirmed Blizzard original pathfinding algorithm.
scope: 2D circular ground bodies, continuous geometric safety, spatial grid routes and discrete holding endpoints.

primarySources.supportedObservation: Public Move, Stop, Hold Position, Attack, Attack-Move and Patrol semantics; physical terrain barriers can prevent movement.
primarySources.notEstablished: Internal path search, grid resolution, collision solver and scheduling.

primarySources.supportedObservation: Units trying to attack one target can be blocked by other units and may seek openings; players may need to select another reachable target.
primarySources.notEstablished: An automatic complete solution of every surround/body-block.

primarySources.supportedObservation: Large units can be difficult to path and can be surrounded or blocked by other units.
primarySources.notEstablished: Exact collision sizes or search costs.

primarySources.supportedObservation: Editor terrain, doodads and buildings define game geometry; spacing and choke points affect movement.

openReference.identity: Independent open-source Warcraft III reimplementation; not Blizzard engine source.

files.observation: Author explicitly describes the search as their naive first A* draft based on Wikipedia; it cannot identify the Blizzard algorithm.
Movement behavior separates static pathing, current body collision and replanning.
